I've attached the onboarding form we tried to submit and a screenshot of the 403 screen (screenshot-403.png). Can you confirm if Redwood's link has any embedded session validation parameters that might conflict with customer IdP sessions?

Hi Samantha — thanks for the clear repro and the attachments.

Quick notes:
- We do not intentionally inject an active session token into the accept link; the link is a short-lived acceptance token (TTL ~ 24 hours) and should redirect to Ariba's hosted acceptance flow.
- That said, we have seen edge cases where an existing IdP session (Okta) + Ariba SSO relayState cause Ariba to revalidate and fail if relayState or saml:sessionIndex is unexpectedly present.

I've looped in Ben (integrations) and Monica (onboarding ops) to investigate whether the token generated for EVB-4127 contains any parameters that could collide with IdP-initiated flows. Can you confirm:
1) Exact URL you clicked (feel free to paste the full URL)
2) Which browser and whether you had the Okta toolbar extension enabled
3) If possible, a HAR or console network log from the failing flow (we can accept a redacted HAR).

Proposed next steps from our side:
- Ben will check the acceptance-token generation and whether we are adding any query params that could be interpreted as a SAML relayState.
- If needed, we can issue a fresh token and ask your admin to try again in a monitored session.

Apologies for the friction — we'll prioritize.

Regards,
David Kim
Senior Manager, Partnerships
Redwood Inference

Hi Samantha — Ben here from Integrations. I dug into the token for EVB-4127 and see two things we should try quickly: 

1) Token paramization: the accept link includes a `next` query parameter that points back to Ariba's accept endpoint. In some IdP flows, Okta rewrites/wraps the `next` URL which can break Ariba's session check. We can issue a compact token URL that omits `next` and performs the redirect server-side.

2) TTL/signing: your token was issued ~22 hours ago. While TTL is 24h, if Ariba does an immediate IdP re-auth check it may reject tokens close to expiry. We'll issue a fresh token with a longer TTL for this partner run.

Quick asks:
- Can you grant a short lived test account (test@everbuild.com) with Okta access and a time window for a remote session? If so, send details privately and we'll remote debug with your admin.
- Alternatively, try the compact token I'll send in a follow-up and report whether incognito is still the only working path.

I'll open a ticket (INF-9842) and attach the logs; Monica will coordinate the Ops side so Tidewater isn't blocked.

Cheers,

Integrations Engineer — Redwood Inference
